title.en: Rectangular Channel: Electric 30 Concrete Pump keeps The motors are 30 kW and 37 kW
title.zh: 矩形 渠道：搜索“30”时，该打开邢台的哪一张泵页保留「没有名为电动低压30的页面。」

description.en: Electric 30 Concrete Pump at /products/electric-30-concrete-pump. The motors are 30 kW and 37 kW The fine-stone pair is 60 m / 180 m
description.zh: 搜索“30”时，该打开邢台的哪一张泵页见 /products/electric-30-concrete-pump。没有名为电动低压30的页面。该页最大骨料为 ≤ 3 cm。

h1.en: Keep Electric 30 Concrete Pump under “Triangular Channel” without new ratings
h1.zh: 在「三角形 渠道」下保留搜索“30”时，该打开邢台的哪一张泵页，不另写额定值

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Electric 30 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/electric-30-concrete-pump. The motors are 30 kW and 37 kW. The fine-stone pair is 60 m / 180 m. The aggregate-13 pair is 20 m / 60 m. Maximum aggregate on the sheet is ≤ 3 cm. See /en/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/. The frame is 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm and 2000 kg. There is no page named Electric Low Pressure 30. Weight is 1200 kg and the frame is 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm. Hebei Pinjin Machinery will not price “a 30” without a path. Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa and 60 m / 180 m. Low-pressure pages start at Electric Low Pressure 40 and Electric Low Pressure 60. Electric 30 shares 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg with Electric Low Pressure 40. If the only clue is “30”, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai has two pump pages, not one. Electric 30 prints a 30 kW motor, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, fine-stone 60 m / 180 m and aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m. The Diesel 30 description attaches “1 cm aggregate” to the 60 m / 180 m pair, and the specification cell prints maximum aggregate 3 cm and below. The section title “Rectangular Channel” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是搜索“30”时，该打开邢台的哪一张泵页的数字。要打开的行是 /products/electric-30-concrete-pump。没有名为电动低压30的页面。该页最大骨料为 ≤ 3 cm。电机是 30 kW 和 37 kW。细石一组是 60 m / 180 m。低压页从电动低压40和电动低压60开始。13 骨料一组是 20 m / 60 m。河北品锦机械不会对没有路径的“一台 30”报价。如果线索只有“30”，河北品锦机械（邢台）有两张泵页，不是一张。外形 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm，重量 2000 kg。重量 1200 kg，外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm。见 /zh/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/。柴油30印 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、60 m / 180 m。电动30与电动低压40共享外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm 和 1200 kg。柴油30的说明把“1 cm 骨料”标在 60 m / 180 m 这一组上，规格格子又印最大骨料 3 cm 及以下。电动30印 30 kW 电机、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、细石 60 m / 180 m、13 骨料 20 m / 60 m。节标题「矩形 渠道」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

There is no page named Electric Low Pressure 30. Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa and 60 m / 180 m. If the only clue is “30”, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai has two pump pages, not one.

body.en: “Triangular Channel” titles this part of the Electric 30 Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. The fine-stone pair is 60 m / 180 m. See /en/products/electric-30-concrete-pump/. Weight is 1200 kg and the frame is 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm. Low-pressure pages start at Electric Low Pressure 40 and Electric Low Pressure 60. Electric 30 prints a 30 kW motor, 12–15 m³/h, 20 MPa, hopper 0.3 m³, fine-stone 60 m / 180 m and aggregate-13 20 m / 60 m.
body.zh: 「三角形 渠道」是搜索“30”时，该打开邢台的哪一张泵页这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。电动30印 30 kW 电机、12–15 m³/h、20 MPa、料斗 0.3 m³、细石 60 m / 180 m、13 骨料 20 m / 60 m。没有名为电动低压30的页面。重量 1200 kg，外形 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm。低压页从电动低压40和电动低压60开始。柴油30的说明把“1 cm 骨料”标在 60 m / 180 m 这一组上，规格格子又印最大骨料 3 cm 及以下。

body.en: For Electric 30 Concrete Pump, the heading “Circular Channel” does not replace a cell. The aggregate-13 pair is 20 m / 60 m. The frame is 4000 × 1500 × 1800 mm and 2000 kg. Hebei Pinjin Machinery will not price “a 30” without a path. Electric 30 shares 3300 × 1500 × 1500 mm and 1200 kg with Electric Low Pressure 40. question.en: Does “Rectangular Channel” replace The motors are 30 kW and 37 kW?
question.zh: 「矩形 渠道」会替换「没有名为电动低压30的页面。」吗？

answer.en: No. The motors are 30 kW and 37 kW remains the printed wording for Electric 30 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。没有名为电动低压30的页面。仍是搜索“30”时，该打开邢台的哪一张泵页已印的说法。

answer.zh: 它属于 /products/electric-30-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。
